description: A post and its comment tree with Reddit's collapsed replies read in. On a big thread Reddit hides part of the tree behind 'load more comments' and 'continue this thread' stubs; this reads those stubs (up to 100 hidden comments per expansion read) and puts the comments back where the stubs were, in the same tree shape as the permalink comment read. `expansion` reports what was read and what is still collapsed (`complete`, `remaining_more_comments`, `stopped_reason`); the returned `after` cursor reads the rest. A flat $0.02 per call; when an expansion read fails, the partial tree comes back and the call is not billed.

after.description: The `after` cursor from a previous answer for the same post, exactly as returned: reads only the comments still collapsed. Absent, the whole thread is read.

id.description: Reddit post id, e.g. '1sgjld3'. A t3_ prefix is optional. Required (path parameter). Required: send `id` or its alias `post_id`.

max_expansions.description: Most expansion reads this call may make, 1-9 (default 9).

post_id.description: Alias of `id`; send one of them. `id` is the canonical name.

sort.description: Comment ordering: confidence (Reddit's best), top, new, controversial, old or qa. Absent, Reddit's default for the thread.

name: reddit_post_comments_expanded
title: Get Expanded Comment Tree
